aesthetic: Scholarly Terroir — warm parchment grounds with sage-green and terracotta punctuation, Palatino serif authority breathing through asymmetric grid layouts with generous whitespace
chromaticArc: Opens on deep charcoal title, warms through parchment and bisque for body slides 2-15, introduces sage green accents as dominant punctuation throughout, terracotta dots appear on transitional slides, returns to charcoal for section dividers at slides 11 and 25, closes warm
gridStrategy: Asymmetric breathing layouts: titles anchored right (col 30-38) or left (col 2-6), body text in narrow columns (span 18-28) with generous whitespace on the opposing side. Image zones balanced against text. Four archetypes cycled: right-anchored title, left-sidebar split, centred column, full-bleed title.

fontStrategy.secondarySlides: Courier New used for data-heavy slides, tables, and code-like content — approximately every 6th slide. Palatino carries all other text.

accentStrategy: Minimal geometry only: thin vertical lines (1px, sage green or forest sage) at column boundaries as margin punctuation on ~40% of slides; small terracotta or warm brown dots (1px) as decorative elements on transitional slides; occasional horizontal rules separating title from body zones. No blocks, bars, or heavy shapes.
